fix_prepared: recreate brtest/brotli with cp -L so the real header files are present, then rerun the same job
method_that_worked: a detached nohup job on the host, launched by a short ssh call; this removed the long-command limit that blocked R403 entirely
not_yet_confirmed: the fix ran as a job but the link degraded before its log could be read

root_cause_found.evidence: listing the directory showed decode.h, encode.h, port.h, shared_dictionary.h and types.h, but md5sum on the same path reported "No such file or directory"
root_cause_found.explanation: dist/include/brotli holds symlinks into the build tree; cp -r copied the links rather than their contents, so the mounted directory contained dangling links
root_cause_found.same_class_as: the R358 NSS header problem, where dist headers pointed at /build/... and were dangling inside a bind mount
root_cause_found.symptom: clang reported "brotli/decode.h file not found" even with -I/t pointing at the directory
